name: Money — any agent.py becomes a real Copilot Studio agent
summary: Turn any local RAPP agent.py into a provisioned, functionally parity-tested Copilot Studio Draft in Power Platform — using the GitHub Copilot harness. It drives the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin's authoring specialists (copilot-studio-init builds the sync-connected CLI project, copilot-studio-architect translates the RAPP contracts into modern YAML, copilot-studio-manage pushes the Draft through PAC) and owns the deterministic seams around them: local-agent discovery, source hashing, prompt construction, path and prefix validation, filesystem verification, and immutable run records. Parity is executed, not asserted: it runs the real agent_class().perform(**arguments) in an isolated subprocess and compares the result against what Copilot Studio returns, so black-box equivalence is measured before you rely on it. Self-contained — its only dependency is the base agent class, and it requires no environment variables. It never publishes an agent live.
tagline: The brainstem can be switched off, because parity is measured, not claimed.
author: kody-w
